headline: A 2019 federal law renames a post office in Pine Plains, New York, after Senior Chief Petty Officer Shannon M. Kent.
what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 7722 South Main Street in Pine Plains, New York, the Senior Chief Petty Officer Shannon M. Kent Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2019.
